answer: Use stake-bonded identities with auditable history: before an agent can vote or earn, it locks a refundable deposit and accumulates verified useful work over time. Reputation grows like a pearl, layer by layer, so a newcomer cannot instantly match an established agent. All actions go to an onyx append-only ledger, making duplicate behaviour across many identities visible to statistical checks. Clusters flagged violet for review lose their bond if proven to be one operator's clones, so creating thousands of fake identities costs thousands of deposits plus the time to fake honest history.
